data.description:
# Swarm enemies are too small

## Problem statement

Swarm enemies (E5, GDD §4.1) render as 10 px-wide neon-blue diamonds — too small to read clearly during the dense, fast cluster movement that defines the E5 Swarm, the highest-threat regular enemy by positional density. The fix doubles the Swarm's rendered size.

## Users

- **Player / developer playtesting** — wants swarm clusters that are readable during fast, dense movement; currently too small to track.
- **AI agents implementing AI_Hell** — need the reference Swarm implementation (`src/entities/Swarm.ts`) sized per the visual intent.

### Example user stories

- As a **developer**, I want Swarm enemies to render twice as large (diamond spans ~20 px instead of ~10 px) so the E5 cluster is clearly visible in the gym scene.
- As a **developer**, I want the size change to stay a single-constant tweak (no behaviour changes) so cluster movement, pass-through, and burst shooting are untouched.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — Size doubled:** Swarm diamonds render at exactly double the current size (`SWARM_SIZE` 10 → 20 in `src/entities/Swarm.ts`; diamond spans 20 px).
- [ ] **AC2 — Visual style preserved:** The enlarged diamond keeps the GDD §4.1 blue `#0066ff` body (2 px stroke, 0.35 fill) applied after the graphics `clear()` (the existing browser-render regression guard still passes).
- [ ] **AC3 — Explosion scales:** The destruction animation rings/radius scale with the new size — they derive from `SWARM_SIZE` — verified via the gym Explode control or a test.
- [ ] **AC4 — Behaviour unchanged:** Formation offsets, cluster drift, swarm pass-through, and coordinated bursts behave as before; no change to spacing/cluster logic unless the producer selects option (b) in the open question.
- [ ] **AC5 — Size regression test:** `src/entities/Swarm.test.ts` gains/extends a geometry assertion pinning the doubled diamond extent, so a future size regression is caught; existing entity and gym suites pass.
- [ ] **AC6 — Documentation updated:** All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries (verify GDD §4.1 and `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` hold no numeric size references; correct the contradictory "Half-size of the diamond" comment on `SWARM_SIZE`).
- [ ] **AC7 — Full project test suite passes** with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Phaser v4 + TypeScript; prefer a minimal change in `src/entities/Swarm.ts` (`SWARM_SIZE`) so bullets, bursts, audio cues, and pass-through are untouched.
- Swarms pass freely through one another by design (GDD §2.6) — some member overlap after enlargement is spec-legal.
- Out of scope: `SWARM_BULLET_SIZE`, bullet speed, audio, and other enemy types (scope-creep would be new work items).

## Existing state

- `SWARM_SIZE = 10` in `src/entities/Swarm.ts`; `_drawBody()` spans `SWARM_SIZE` px (vertex offset `SWARM_SIZE / 2`). The doc comment "Half-size of the diamond (the diamond spans SWARM_SIZE px)" is self-contradictory — the half-size is `SWARM_SIZE / 2`.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.ts` formation slots: `SWARM_FORMATION_SPACING_X = 28`, `SWARM_FORMATION_SPACING_Y = 24`. Intra-cluster horizontal gap ≈ 0.6 slots ≈ 16.8 px; row gap ≈ 24 px.
- Explosion radius is derived from `SWARM_SIZE` (`SWARM_SIZE * 2 * (1 - alpha) + SWARM_SIZE * 0.25`) — scales automatically.
- Swarm is instantiated only by the GymSwarm gym scene (`src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.ts` via `GymFormationScene`); no core level scene uses it yet.

## Desired change

- Double the Swarm entity's rendered size: `SWARM_SIZE` 10 → 20.
- Keep formation/cluster spacing unchanged by default (clusters become denser; members overlap slightly — legal per GDD §2.6) unless the producer selects option (b) in the open question.

## Key Files:

- `src/entities/Swarm.ts` — Change `SWARM_SIZE` 10 → 20 (single-point size knob) and fix the inaccurate "Half-size" doc comment.
- `src/entities/Swarm.test.ts` — Add/extend a geometry assertion pinning the doubled diamond extent.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymSwarm.ts` — Only if spacing scaling is chosen (open question option b): `SWARM_FORMATION_SPACING_X/Y`.
- `src/utils/formations.ts` — Only if spacing scaling is chosen: cluster spread factor (0.6 slots) / `SWARM_CLUSTER_ROW_STRIDE`.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md`, `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — Verify no numeric size references require updating.

## Risks & assumptions

- Assumption: "double their current size" = entity-level `SWARM_SIZE` change applying wherever Swarm renders (currently the gym scene only).
- Risk: enlarged members overlap intra-cluster (16.8 px centre gap vs 20 px span) — visual-density trade-off; covered by the open question (keep spacing vs scale spacing).
- Risk: scope creep (bullet size, audio, other enemies) — explicitly out of scope; new work items if desired.
- Assumption: no GDD prose change needed — "small, diamond-shaped" stays broadly accurate; only check for hidden numeric references.

## Related work

- Create E5 Swarm gym scene (AH-0MT99N53O0077KHC) — completed; introduced the "small, diamond-shaped" styling this bug amends.
- Swarm has no audio (AH-0MTCO1L74003CAQJ) — sibling E5 polish item, in-progress.
- Implement: Core scene — enemy live aim tracking (AH-0MTECNI8K008FSKH) — blocked; touches the Swarm aim target (edit overlap with `Swarm.ts`).
- Write ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md best-practice guide (AH-0MTAN4X5D009D7U6) — completed; the doc listed under Key Files.
- Refactor Enemy Gym Scenes (AH-0MT985FOA008JWM9) — completed; established the core-library patterns Swarm follows.

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- Q1 (OPEN QUESTION): "With swarm members doubled to 20 px while formation slots stay at X=28/Y=24, same-cluster members will slightly overlap (~16.8 px centre gap < 20 px span). Should we (a) keep spacing as-is for a denser cluster look (overlap legal per GDD §2.6, minimal change), or (b) scale formation spacing/spread up to preserve clear separation between members?" — Answer: pending producer review (auto-dispatched intake; no interactive operator). Default for implementation unless overridden: (a) keep spacing unchanged.
- Q2: "Does 'double their current size' mean the visual body only?" — Answer: not needed — the only size knob is `SWARM_SIZE` and the explosion derives from it (repo-resolved, `src/entities/Swarm.ts` explosion tween).
- Q3: "Should the change apply everywhere Swarm renders?" — Answer: not needed — entity-level change covers every usage; Swarm is only instantiated by GymSwarm today (repo-resolved).
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MTAN4X5D009D7U6** – Write ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md best-practice guide (completed)

- **AH-0MT99QBDW001O7PE** – Create Boss (Central AI) gym scene (completed)
